title: Asset status changed
description: This event occurs when an asset's status changes with product interest management. It is published by the treasury confirmation step of the closing process when a pending asset is activated.

external_asset_id.title: External asset ID
external_asset_id.description: Unique asset short identifier defined by Pismo.

issuer_id.title: Issuer ID
issuer_id.description: Cetip code of registrator of asset. This is part of the asset identifier on the Pismo platform. An organization can have multiple issuer IDs.
